recent_posts.title: JavaScript TC39 proposals out of the blue
recent_posts.summary: Two TC39 proposals are introduced to address inefficiencies in handling network data in JavaScript. The first, `ArrayBuffer.prototype.detach`, allows manual clearing of ArrayBuffers after parsing to free memory immediately rather than waiting for GC. The second, `JSON.parseBinary`, enables parsing JSON directly from binary data (ArrayBuffer) without the intermediate UTF-16 string conversion step, eliminating wasted CPU time and memory when payloads are invalid or contain multi-byte characters like emojis.

recent_posts.title: Electron IPC has scaling issues.
recent_posts.summary: Electron IPC suffers from string-based channels, lack of type safety, and manual process synchronization, causing runtime errors and maintenance headaches as apps scale. A contract-first approach using Protobuf is proposed as a solution to enforce type safety and reduce channel name typos and argument mismatches.

recent_posts.title: Multi-Tenant-SaaS-Starter-NestJS
recent_posts.summary: A starter template repository for building multi-tenant SaaS applications using NestJS framework. Provides boilerplate code and architecture patterns for implementing tenant isolation, database separation, and common SaaS features in Node.js applications. Includes authentication, authorization, and tenant management capabilities out of the box.

recent_posts.title: Tired of Google Places API Bills? Meet OpenPOI: A High-Performance, Self-Healing POI Service
recent_posts.summary: OpenPOI is a self-hosted alternative to Google Places API that uses OpenStreetMap data with a three-layer caching architecture (Redis, MongoDB, Overpass API). The system features a self-healing background worker that proactively fetches and caches POI data for surrounding areas using hexagonal scanning, ensuring millisecond response times for subsequent queries. It offers hybrid search capabilities, simplified opening hours parsing, and is available on RapidAPI with a free tier.

recent_posts.title: Shortcut for Developers: Stop Wasting Time on YouTube API Integration!
recent_posts.summary: A microservice API on RapidAPI provides YouTube video scraping capabilities without requiring developers to build or maintain scraper infrastructure. The service handles proxy management, caching, and YouTube interface changes while delivering clean JSON output with best audio, video, and combined format links. Integration requires just a few lines of Node.js code using axios.

recent_posts.title: Your Tabs Are Lying to Each Other — Let’s Fix That (Pinia Cross-Tab Sync)
recent_posts.summary: Wikipinia is a Pinia plugin that synchronizes state across multiple browser tabs in Vue 3 applications. It uses the BroadcastChannel API with localStorage fallback to broadcast store changes, featuring initial state handshakes, selective syncing, patch-based updates, and conflict resolution. The plugin addresses real-world issues where multi-tab usage causes state drift and stale data, providing a shared source of truth across tabs. Currently in active development with known edge cases being addressed.

recent_posts.title: A No Frills, No BS Website To Convert Spreadsheets to Database Queries
recent_posts.summary: A client-side web tool built with Vue3 and Vite converts spreadsheet data into database queries without requiring servers, backends, or data collection. The tool processes everything in the browser, offering a privacy-focused solution for developers who need to transform spreadsheet data into SQL INSERT statements for various databases.

recent_posts.title: “Overqualified” – 6-month update from inside the same company
recent_posts.summary: A developer shares their 6-month journey after being labeled 'overqualified' during an internal application. They transitioned to a Junior IT Engineer role within the same company, handling day-to-day tasks like printer support, DHCP management, and internal tools while building a POS-lite side project using Java, Spring Boot, and React. The update reflects on navigating career pivots, dealing with workplace labels, and finding better role alignment.

recent_posts.title: This is a good understandable example of using three.js and GSAP.
recent_posts.summary: A video tutorial demonstrating how to create 3D web graphics using Three.js and GSAP animation library within a Next.js application. The tutorial covers building a properly lit and shaded rotating globe, implementing scroll-zoom animations, and integrating these 3D elements into a web page. After initial Next.js setup, the content focuses on detailed Three.js implementation with clear explanations.

recent_posts.title: LogTape, a simple logging library with zero dependencies for Deno, Node.js, Bun, browsers, and edge functions
recent_posts.summary: LogTape is a zero-dependency logging library for JavaScript and TypeScript that works across Node.js, Deno, Bun, browsers, and edge functions. It features a library-first design that allows library authors to add logging without burdening end-users with configuration. The library supports structured logging, hierarchical categories, context management, data redaction, and integrates with popular tools like Pino, Winston, Sentry, and AWS CloudWatch.
